steps.text: Beat cream cheese, butter, orange juice, and orange zest in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until creamy. Gradually mix in confectioner's sugar until blended and smooth.

raw_recipe.headline: Orange Cream Cheese Frosting
raw_recipe.description: Looking for an orange cake icing? This decadent cream cheese frosting is bursting with fresh citrus flavor. Try it on your favorite cakes and cookies!
raw_recipe.name: Orange Cream Cheese Frosting

recipeInstructions.text: Beat cream cheese, butter, orange juice, and orange zest in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until creamy. Gradually mix in confectioner's sugar until blended and smooth.

review.reviewBody: This turned out good in the end, but needed a little tweaking. I followed the recipe, but stopped at 2 cups of sugar and 1 tbsp of orange juice. At that point, it was plenty sweet enough and adding the rest of the juice would have made it too runny. It still needed more flavoring though, so I added another 1/2 teaspoon of zest. The yield was substantially shy of 3 cups, and I can't see leaving out the 1/2 cup of sugar affecting that outcome. Good to know if you are expecting or needing the full yield. I would make this again, but may try increasing the cream cheese and using orange juice concentrate instead of juice.

Delicious frosting! I found the texture to be perfect for the citrus cake I made recently. I think if it is turning out too runny for you, the most likely culprit is butter and/or cream cheese that you either a) melted or softened too much in the microwave, or b) you allowed it to get too warm on the counter and it went from soft to almost melted. Next time, try letting it sit out until JUST slightly softened. I think you will be much happier with the results. Loved this frosting!! I have made it several times now, and my favorite tweak is to add 1 tablespoon orange juice concentrate in place of the 2 tbls. orange juice. Really adds a punch when you want a stronger orange flavor. I also add a bit more zest and usually leave out the walnuts - just personal preference.

This is a great companion recipe for the Orange Cake recipe on this site by Angie LaSala. Changes: I added 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, increased zest to a good 1 1/2 tsp, used 4 oz cream cheese and used unsalted butter but added a scan 1/8 tsp salt and used the 3/4 C nuts called for SOOOOOO GOOOOOOOD!!!!! Lol

I followed the advice of others. I upped the cream cheese to 4 0z. and reduced the orange juice to 1 Tbsp. I added a drop of wild orange essential oil to the mix for added flavour. I only used 1 cup of icing sugar. It was the right consistency but far to sweet for my palate. Does anyone have any ideas on how to reduce the sweetness? I'm thinking of trying to use honey as the sweetener.
I removed the walnuts and added Cocoa powder for a Chocolate Orange frosting that turned out just perfect. Great recipe!!!

I omitted 1 tbsp of orange juice to avoid it being too runny. Since I was making frosting for cupcakes, I wanted it a bit firm for piping. If I were to use this for cinnamon buns, I'd probably follow the recipe exactly. Great flavor!

Uber easy! I used lemon extract and dried orange peel in mine, plus a little less confectioners sugar (2 cups), a little more cream cheese (4 oz) and it is very nice. Used it atop pumpkin bread. Very easy to make a and tweak to your taste. Thanks!

very good on its own but a mod by increasing zest to 1/4 cup and oj to same as well as 2 tbs of grand marnier Orange liqueur and 500 grams (1 lb)icing sugar did the trick. Beat very well and the orange flavour was outstading on a betty Crocker pre-mix carrot cake

I used this frosting with the Extreme Chocolate Cake recipe from this site and it was an amazing combination! Everyone raved about it. The only change I made was to use just 1 tablespoon of OJ as one reviewer suggested for the texture. Perfect! Thanks

Great recipe! I gave it 4 stars because I had to change a lot, but with my changes I'd give it 5 stars! I doubled the cream cheese and the orange zest, halved the orange juice and also added an extra cup of confectionery sugar because it was too runny (probably because of the extra cream cheese). We will definitely make this again! Very yummy!

I excluded the sugar and nuts and put in 1 ts of vanilla extract and 1 more ts of orange zest instead. Texture was great. I spread it ontop of a almond and orange gluton and sugar free cake I made and topped the frosting with sliced almonds.
NOT BIG ON FLAVOR WON'T BE MAKING THIS OR ORANDE CAKE
Added vanilla flavor cap full
I found this icing very runny and very sweet. The orange flavour was delicious but I would tweak it if I made it again.
Delicious! We loved it!
This is what I use as a topping for the Cranberry Apple Bread. A little goes a long way in taste.
I made this for my whole family and they loved it they kept asking me what I put in the cream cheese frosting some I told and some said it was a secret
Added a dash or 2 of sea salt. Yes definitely. I frosted a boxed cake for a gathering .I normally do not use boxed anything and it made a wonderful tasting cake.
Great flavor that complemented carrot cake cupcakes that I made.

This frosting is perfect! I put it on vanilla cupcakes, but first I put vanilla cream in the center of the cupcake then I put the orange cream cheese frosting. They were a hit with the family. Thanks for the recipe!!!
